correctness.rationale: The directed graph has exactly fourteen arcs on the uneven theta with paths 2,2,3. Independently enumerated 280 nonempty valid arc sets by indegree/outdegree <=1 and absence of directed cycles, face vector (14,64,114,76,12). Independently repeated deterministic face-poset cancellation: 134 elementary acyclic matches, critical cells one vertex, five 2-cells, six 3-cells. Independently built the full 280-face Hasse digraph and verified acyclicity, and evaluated all integral Morse projections by signed face orientations: every critical differential is zero. The 2-skeleton of the resulting CW complex is wedge^5 S2; Hurewicz identifies each 3-cell attaching class with its zero H2 column, hence all 3-cell attachments null and the claimed wedge^5 S2 wedge^6 S3 follows integrally.
